meta.title: Dreams Left by the River of Forgetting
meta.description: Pain and love alike settle with the dust of days gone by.

units.rawText: The Oasis, Headquarters.
units.displayText: The Oasis, Headquarters.

spans.text: The Oasis, Headquarters.

units.rawText: Welcome back, Professor. Did you take care of everything in the real world?
units.displayText: Welcome back, Professor. Did you take care of everything in the real world?

spans.text: Welcome back, Professor. Did you take care of everything in the real world?

units.rawText: Yeah. Dr. Persicaria and I are discussing setting up the new Magrasea server, and transferring your entropy permissions.
units.displayText: Yeah. Dr. Persicaria and I are discussing setting up the new Magrasea server, and transferring your entropy permissions.

spans.text: Yeah. Dr. Persicaria and I are discussing setting up the new Magrasea server, and transferring your entropy permissions.

units.rawText: Good thing time flows differently on each side and they don't affect each other. Otherwise, I'd have a hard time handling both on my own.
units.displayText: Good thing time flows differently on each side and they don't affect each other. Otherwise, I'd have a hard time handling both on my own.

spans.text: Good thing time flows differently on each side and they don't affect each other. Otherwise, I'd have a hard time handling both on my own.

units.rawText: Thank you for all your hard work, Professor. I hope you can get some proper rest while you're in the Oasis.
units.displayText: Thank you for all your hard work, Professor. I hope you can get some proper rest while you're in the Oasis.

spans.text: Thank you for all your hard work, Professor. I hope you can get some proper rest while you're in the Oasis.

units.rawText: Oh, that's right. A new Doll arrived today to help you with your work. Her name is...
units.displayText: Oh, that's right. A new Doll arrived today to help you with your work. Her name is...

spans.text: Oh, that's right. A new Doll arrived today to help you with your work. Her name is...

units.rawText: Knock knock—
units.displayText: Knock knock—

spans.text: Knock knock—

units.rawText: Before Persicaria could finish, a polite knock sounded right on cue.
units.displayText: Before Persicaria could finish, a polite knock sounded right on cue.

spans.text: Before Persicaria could finish, a polite knock sounded right on cue.

units.rawText: Come in.
units.displayText: Come in.

spans.text: Come in.

units.rawText: Hello, Professor. It's a pleasure to meet you.
units.displayText: Hello, Professor. It's a pleasure to meet you.

spans.text: Hello, Professor. It's a pleasure to meet you.

units.rawText: Yours truly is Inola, newly arrived at the Oasis. I'm the secretary assigned to assist you with your work.
units.displayText: Yours truly is Inola, newly arrived at the Oasis. I'm the secretary assigned to assist you with your work.

spans.text: Yours truly is Inola, newly arrived at the Oasis. I'm the secretary assigned to assist you with your work.

units.rawText: Secretary?
units.displayText: Secretary?

spans.text: Secretary?

units.rawText: Yes, allow me to introduce her. This is Miss Inola from UAS. Starting today, she'll be helping you with all kinds of Oasis affairs.
units.displayText: Yes, allow me to introduce her. This is Miss Inola from UAS. Starting today, she'll be helping you with all kinds of Oasis affairs.

spans.text: Yes, allow me to introduce her. This is Miss Inola from UAS. Starting today, she'll be helping you with all kinds of Oasis affairs.

units.rawText: Yours truly may be a catgirl too, but please don't lump me together with Miss Persicaria, hm?
units.displayText: Yours truly may be a catgirl too, but please don't lump me together with Miss Persicaria, hm?

spans.text: Yours truly may be a catgirl too, but please don't lump me together with Miss Persicaria, hm?

units.rawText: Just the way you refer to yourself makes the difference pretty clear... Sorry, I know you just got here, but could you start working right away?
units.displayText: Just the way you refer to yourself makes the difference pretty clear... Sorry, I know you just got here, but could you start working right away?

spans.text: Just the way you refer to yourself makes the difference pretty clear... Sorry, I know you just got here, but could you start working right away?

units.rawText: A lot of work piled up while I was gone. I don't think I can finish it all without pulling an all-nighter...
units.displayText: A lot of work piled up while I was gone. I don't think I can finish it all without pulling an all-nighter...

spans.text: A lot of work piled up while I was gone. I don't think I can finish it all without pulling an all-nighter...

units.rawText: Oh, that won't do~
units.displayText: Oh, that won't do~

spans.text: Oh, that won't do~

units.rawText: A slender, fluffy tail wrapped around my arm, firmly pulling me away from the work reports on the desk.
units.displayText: A slender, fluffy tail wrapped around my arm, firmly pulling me away from the work reports on the desk.

spans.text: A slender, fluffy tail wrapped around my arm, firmly pulling me away from the work reports on the desk.

units.rawText: Professor, are you so busy that you'd even borrow a cat's paw?
units.displayText: Professor, are you so busy that you'd even borrow a cat's paw?

spans.text: Professor, are you so busy that you'd even borrow a cat's paw?

units.rawText: I may well be a cat, but I only arrived at the Oasis today and know nothing about this place. Even if I wanted to help, I wouldn't know where to start.
units.displayText: I may well be a cat, but I only arrived at the Oasis today and know nothing about this place. Even if I wanted to help, I wouldn't know where to start.

spans.text: I may well be a cat, but I only arrived at the Oasis today and know nothing about this place. Even if I wanted to help, I wouldn't know where to start.

units.rawText: If I jumped in now and made a mistake in the rush, it would only double the work.
units.displayText: If I jumped in now and made a mistake in the rush, it would only double the work.

spans.text: If I jumped in now and made a mistake in the rush, it would only double the work.

units.rawText: Ah, sorry... You're right. I was getting a bit too impatient.
units.displayText: Ah, sorry... You're right. I was getting a bit too impatient.

spans.text: Ah, sorry... You're right. I was getting a bit too impatient.

units.rawText: No need to apologize. Instead, as compensation, would you show yours truly around the Oasis?
units.displayText: No need to apologize. Instead, as compensation, would you show yours truly around the Oasis?

spans.text: No need to apologize. Instead, as compensation, would you show yours truly around the Oasis?

units.rawText: After all, I've only just joined, and I don't know much about how things work here yet.
units.displayText: After all, I've only just joined, and I don't know much about how things work here yet.

spans.text: After all, I've only just joined, and I don't know much about how things work here yet.

units.rawText: Or perhaps...
units.displayText: Or perhaps...

spans.text: Or perhaps...

units.rawText: Her tail tightened, and Inola leaned her whole body against my shoulder. In an instant, her distinctive fragrance filled my nose.
units.displayText: Her tail tightened, and Inola leaned her whole body against my shoulder. In an instant, her distinctive fragrance filled my nose.

spans.text: Her tail tightened, and Inola leaned her whole body against my shoulder. In an instant, her distinctive fragrance filled my nose.

units.rawText: You'd rather stay here and get to know yours truly up close~ and~ per~ so~ nal~ ly~?
units.displayText: You'd rather stay here and get to know yours truly up close~ and~ per~ so~ nal~ ly~?

spans.text: You'd rather stay here and get to know yours truly up close~ and~ per~ so~ nal~ ly~?

units.rawText: Well...
units.displayText: Well...

spans.text: Well...

units.rawText: ...Ahem!
units.displayText: ...Ahem!

spans.text: ...Ahem!

units.rawText: Oh my, what thick killing intent~
units.displayText: Oh my, what thick killing intent~

spans.text: Oh my, what thick killing intent~

units.rawText: Inola stuck out her tongue, let go, and moved to the side of the desk.
units.displayText: Inola stuck out her tongue, let go, and moved to the side of the desk.

spans.text: Inola stuck out her tongue, let go, and moved to the side of the desk.

units.rawText: Don't worry, Miss Persicaria. Yours truly has no interest in being a cat who steals someone else's fish.
units.displayText: Don't worry, Miss Persicaria. Yours truly has no interest in being a cat who steals someone else's fish.

spans.text: Don't worry, Miss Persicaria. Yours truly has no interest in being a cat who steals someone else's fish.

units.rawText: ...Ahem! I just wanted to remind you both to mind the distance. Nothing more.
units.displayText: ...Ahem! I just wanted to remind you both to mind the distance. Nothing more.

spans.text: ...Ahem! I just wanted to remind you both to mind the distance. Nothing more.

units.rawText: But I do agree with the idea of a tour around the Oasis, Professor.
units.displayText: But I do agree with the idea of a tour around the Oasis, Professor.

spans.text: But I do agree with the idea of a tour around the Oasis, Professor.

units.rawText: A lot has changed in Magrasea while you were away... The Oasis and everyone in it have kept growing for the better.
units.displayText: A lot has changed in Magrasea while you were away... The Oasis and everyone in it have kept growing for the better.

spans.text: A lot has changed in Magrasea while you were away... The Oasis and everyone in it have kept growing for the better.

units.rawText: She turned off the window's simulated projection, revealing a corner of the renewed Oasis beyond the glass.
units.displayText: She turned off the window's simulated projection, revealing a corner of the renewed Oasis beyond the glass.

spans.text: She turned off the window's simulated projection, revealing a corner of the renewed Oasis beyond the glass.

units.rawText: Through the postwar reconstruction, ever-advancing technology had breathed a new kind of life into the whole Oasis.
units.displayText: Through the postwar reconstruction, ever-advancing technology had breathed a new kind of life into the whole Oasis.

spans.text: Through the postwar reconstruction, ever-advancing technology had breathed a new kind of life into the whole Oasis.

units.rawText: Rather than reading numbers on paper, seeing it with your own eyes will let you feel the difference much more directly.
units.displayText: Rather than reading numbers on paper, seeing it with your own eyes will let you feel the difference much more directly.

spans.text: Rather than reading numbers on paper, seeing it with your own eyes will let you feel the difference much more directly.

units.rawText: If you both say so... Alright, let me sign a few more documents and then we'll go.
units.displayText: If you both say so... Alright, let me sign a few more documents and then we'll go.

spans.text: If you both say so... Alright, let me sign a few more documents and then we'll go.

units.rawText: No need to worry about that. Yours truly has already organized the documents on the desk into your terminal, so you can process them remotely anytime.
units.displayText: No need to worry about that. Yours truly has already organized the documents on the desk into your terminal, so you can process them remotely anytime.

spans.text: No need to worry about that. Yours truly has already organized the documents on the desk into your terminal, so you can process them remotely anytime.

units.rawText: Huh? When? I didn't even notice...
units.displayText: Huh? When? I didn't even notice...

spans.text: Huh? When? I didn't even notice...

units.rawText: Just now, while Miss Persicaria had your attention~
units.displayText: Just now, while Miss Persicaria had your attention~

spans.text: Just now, while Miss Persicaria had your attention~

units.rawText: She suddenly leaned forward, rose onto her tiptoes, and whispered into my ear.
units.displayText: She suddenly leaned forward, rose onto her tiptoes, and whispered into my ear.

spans.text: She suddenly leaned forward, rose onto her tiptoes, and whispered into my ear.

units.rawText: Professor, a perfect secretary can read people's hearts, you know~
units.displayText: Professor, a perfect secretary can read people's hearts, you know~

spans.text: Professor, a perfect secretary can read people's hearts, you know~

units.rawText: This is the Oasis Plaza...? I didn't expect it to have changed so much since last time.
units.displayText: This is the Oasis Plaza...? I didn't expect it to have changed so much since last time.

spans.text: This is the Oasis Plaza...? I didn't expect it to have changed so much since last time.

units.rawText: Strolling across the Oasis Plaza with Inola, I couldn't hide my amazement at all the buildings raised after the war.
units.displayText: Strolling across the Oasis Plaza with Inola, I couldn't hide my amazement at all the buildings raised after the war.

spans.text: Strolling across the Oasis Plaza with Inola, I couldn't hide my amazement at all the buildings raised after the war.

units.rawText: Don't tell me this is the new Oasis Tower Croque mentioned before? Last time I was here it was only a concept sketch... And how on earth did she convince Puzzle to approve all these life-size Armed Mecha statues?
units.displayText: Don't tell me this is the new Oasis Tower Croque mentioned before? Last time I was here it was only a concept sketch... And how on earth did she convince Puzzle to approve all these life-size Armed Mecha statues?

spans.text: Don't tell me this is the new Oasis Tower Croque mentioned before? Last time I was here it was only a concept sketch... And how on earth did she convince Puzzle to approve all these life-size Armed Mecha statues?

units.rawText: Ah... is this the Rest Zone? It looks the same from the outside, but it's gotten so much bigger.
units.displayText: Ah... is this the Rest Zone? It looks the same from the outside, but it's gotten so much bigger.

spans.text: Ah... is this the Rest Zone? It looks the same from the outside, but it's gotten so much bigger.

units.rawText: Of course. It may have been only a short while in reality for you, Professor, but years have passed in Magrasea, you know?
units.displayText: Of course. It may have been only a short while in reality for you, Professor, but years have passed in Magrasea, you know?

spans.text: Of course. It may have been only a short while in reality for you, Professor, but years have passed in Magrasea, you know?

units.rawText: Only after experiencing it myself do I understand what it feels like when time moves on and everything changes...
units.displayText: Only after experiencing it myself do I understand what it feels like when time moves on and everything changes...

spans.text: Only after experiencing it myself do I understand what it feels like when time moves on and everything changes...

units.rawText: I see. It's been that long since that battle...
units.displayText: I see. It's been that long since that battle...

spans.text: I see. It's been that long since that battle...

units.rawText: Save the sentiment for later, Professor. Wasn't the point of this outing to show me around the Oasis?
units.displayText: Save the sentiment for later, Professor. Wasn't the point of this outing to show me around the Oasis?

spans.text: Save the sentiment for later, Professor. Wasn't the point of this outing to show me around the Oasis?

units.rawText: Inola hopped in front of me and gave a bewitching smile.
units.displayText: Inola hopped in front of me and gave a bewitching smile.

spans.text: Inola hopped in front of me and gave a bewitching smile.

units.rawText: Or perhaps... you were so excited about our date that you forgot?
units.displayText: Or perhaps... you were so excited about our date that you forgot?

spans.text: Or perhaps... you were so excited about our date that you forgot?

units.rawText: You're right, I wasn't being considerate of you...
units.displayText: You're right, I wasn't being considerate of you...

spans.text: You're right, I wasn't being considerate of you...

units.rawText: Hehehe, yours truly was only joking~
units.displayText: Hehehe, yours truly was only joking~

spans.text: Hehehe, yours truly was only joking~

units.rawText: One of the reasons for this walk is for you to relax. If you get serious about work, wouldn't that defeat the purpose?
units.displayText: One of the reasons for this walk is for you to relax. If you get serious about work, wouldn't that defeat the purpose?

spans.text: One of the reasons for this walk is for you to relax. If you get serious about work, wouldn't that defeat the purpose?

units.rawText: Still... seeing you flustered isn't bad at all. You're even cuter than yours truly imagined~
units.displayText: Still... seeing you flustered isn't bad at all. You're even cuter than yours truly imagined~

spans.text: Still... seeing you flustered isn't bad at all. You're even cuter than yours truly imagined~

units.rawText: Before I could reply, she hugged her notebook, stepped back behind me, and jotted something down with a sly grin.
units.displayText: Before I could reply, she hugged her notebook, stepped back behind me, and jotted something down with a sly grin.

spans.text: Before I could reply, she hugged her notebook, stepped back behind me, and jotted something down with a sly grin.

units.rawText: Inola, what's that notebook?
units.displayText: Inola, what's that notebook?

spans.text: Inola, what's that notebook?

units.rawText: It's yours truly's personal notebook for keeping records. Don't worry, I've already noted the data on those buildings. You need only keep leading the way.
units.displayText: It's yours truly's personal notebook for keeping records. Don't worry, I've already noted the data on those buildings. You need only keep leading the way.

spans.text: It's yours truly's personal notebook for keeping records. Don't worry, I've already noted the data on those buildings. You need only keep leading the way.

units.rawText: Recording things with pen and paper in the information age is rather unusual... Professor, do you think my way is old-fashioned?
units.displayText: Recording things with pen and paper in the information age is rather unusual... Professor, do you think my way is old-fashioned?

spans.text: Recording things with pen and paper in the information age is rather unusual... Professor, do you think my way is old-fashioned?

units.rawText: Not at all. I just think you're really diligent and meticulous as a secretary, Inola.
units.displayText: Not at all. I just think you're really diligent and meticulous as a secretary, Inola.

spans.text: Not at all. I just think you're really diligent and meticulous as a secretary, Inola.

units.rawText: Mew?!
units.displayText: Mew?!

spans.text: Mew?!

units.rawText: ...Mew?
units.displayText: ...Mew?

spans.text: ...Mew?

units.rawText: Like a startled cat, Inola's tail shot straight up, but she quickly hid her face behind the notebook and regained her composure.
units.displayText: Like a startled cat, Inola's tail shot straight up, but she quickly hid her face behind the notebook and regained her composure.

spans.text: Like a startled cat, Inola's tail shot straight up, but she quickly hid her face behind the notebook and regained her composure.

units.rawText: ...It's nothing. Weren't you in the middle of showing me around? Please continue.
units.displayText: ...It's nothing. Weren't you in the middle of showing me around? Please continue.

spans.text: ...It's nothing. Weren't you in the middle of showing me around? Please continue.

units.rawText: Sorry, sorry. I almost forgot the most important part.
units.displayText: Sorry, sorry. I almost forgot the most important part.

spans.text: Sorry, sorry. I almost forgot the most important part.

units.rawText: Oh, did you notice that structure up ahead? It's a memorial built with help gathered from every sector, to honor the Dolls and Agents who gave their lives in the battles.
units.displayText: Oh, did you notice that structure up ahead? It's a memorial built with help gathered from every sector, to honor the Dolls and Agents who gave their lives in the battles.

spans.text: Oh, did you notice that structure up ahead? It's a memorial built with help gathered from every sector, to honor the Dolls and Agents who gave their lives in the battles.

units.rawText: Every time I come back, the first thing I do is come here and offer them my respects and some flowers.
units.displayText: Every time I come back, the first thing I do is come here and offer them my respects and some flowers.

spans.text: Every time I come back, the first thing I do is come here and offer them my respects and some flowers.

units.rawText: I laid down the pure white bouquet I'd brought. Seeing this, Inola followed my lead, offering the bouquet I'd handed her earlier and paying her respects.
units.displayText: I laid down the pure white bouquet I'd brought. Seeing this, Inola followed my lead, offering the bouquet I'd handed her earlier and paying her respects.

spans.text: I laid down the pure white bouquet I'd brought. Seeing this, Inola followed my lead, offering the bouquet I'd handed her earlier and paying her respects.

units.rawText: ...Thank you. I think they'd be glad to see a new Doll like you join the Oasis.
units.displayText: ...Thank you. I think they'd be glad to see a new Doll like you join the Oasis.

spans.text: ...Thank you. I think they'd be glad to see a new Doll like you join the Oasis.

units.rawText: By the way, Professor, there's something yours truly doesn't understand.
units.displayText: By the way, Professor, there's something yours truly doesn't understand.

spans.text: By the way, Professor, there's something yours truly doesn't understand.

units.rawText: Everything in Magrasea is heading in a good direction, but... have all the crises really been resolved?
units.displayText: Everything in Magrasea is heading in a good direction, but... have all the crises really been resolved?

spans.text: Everything in Magrasea is heading in a good direction, but... have all the crises really been resolved?

units.rawText: Inola lowered her head, her cat ears and tail drooping along with it.
units.displayText: Inola lowered her head, her cat ears and tail drooping along with it.

spans.text: Inola lowered her head, her cat ears and tail drooping along with it.

units.rawText: ...I never saw the battlefield of the Oasis. All I know of what happened in Magrasea back then is what I read on paper.
units.displayText: ...I never saw the battlefield of the Oasis. All I know of what happened in Magrasea back then is what I read on paper.

spans.text: ...I never saw the battlefield of the Oasis. All I know of what happened in Magrasea back then is what I read on paper.

units.rawText: At the time, I was hiding in the Cat Ecology Sector... and then it felt as though the entire Cloud was being torn apart.
units.displayText: At the time, I was hiding in the Cat Ecology Sector... and then it felt as though the entire Cloud was being torn apart.

spans.text: At the time, I was hiding in the Cat Ecology Sector... and then it felt as though the entire Cloud was being torn apart.

units.rawText: Inola's body trembled slightly, as if the terror of the Cloud's collapse still hung over her mind.
units.displayText: Inola's body trembled slightly, as if the terror of the Cloud's collapse still hung over her mind.

spans.text: Inola's body trembled slightly, as if the terror of the Cloud's collapse still hung over her mind.

units.rawText: Just when I thought it was all over and I was ready to accept my fate... I came to my senses and it had all ended.
units.displayText: Just when I thought it was all over and I was ready to accept my fate... I came to my senses and it had all ended.

spans.text: Just when I thought it was all over and I was ready to accept my fate... I came to my senses and it had all ended.

units.rawText: Was resolving the Cloud's crisis... all your doing, Professor?
units.displayText: Was resolving the Cloud's crisis... all your doing, Professor?

spans.text: Was resolving the Cloud's crisis... all your doing, Professor?

units.rawText: Hmm... That's a long story.
units.displayText: Hmm... That's a long story.

spans.text: Hmm... That's a long story.

units.rawText: But I can say one thing for sure. Making it to the new server wasn't my doing alone. It was a miracle born from everyone's efforts.
units.displayText: But I can say one thing for sure. Making it to the new server wasn't my doing alone. It was a miracle born from everyone's efforts.

spans.text: But I can say one thing for sure. Making it to the new server wasn't my doing alone. It was a miracle born from everyone's efforts.

units.rawText: As for the crises you mentioned... at least for now, we're safe.
units.displayText: As for the crises you mentioned... at least for now, we're safe.

spans.text: As for the crises you mentioned... at least for now, we're safe.

units.rawText: The pain of war fades with time, but some wounds are never healed by time.
units.displayText: The pain of war fades with time, but some wounds are never healed by time.

spans.text: The pain of war fades with time, but some wounds are never healed by time.

units.rawText: I ran my hand along the stone pillar and smiled at Inola.
units.displayText: I ran my hand along the stone pillar and smiled at Inola.

spans.text: I ran my hand along the stone pillar and smiled at Inola.

units.rawText: Scars don't disappear. But by the same token, neither does hope.
units.displayText: Scars don't disappear. But by the same token, neither does hope.

spans.text: Scars don't disappear. But by the same token, neither does hope.

units.rawText: Every inch of the reborn Oasis is something we built with our hopes for the future. The hope planted here will sprout strong someday.
units.displayText: Every inch of the reborn Oasis is something we built with our hopes for the future. The hope planted here will sprout strong someday.

spans.text: Every inch of the reborn Oasis is something we built with our hopes for the future. The hope planted here will sprout strong someday.

units.rawText: Inola thought for a moment, then came to stand beside me, shoulder to shoulder.
units.displayText: Inola thought for a moment, then came to stand beside me, shoulder to shoulder.

spans.text: Inola thought for a moment, then came to stand beside me, shoulder to shoulder.

units.rawText: Then leave the careful tending to yours truly.
units.displayText: Then leave the careful tending to yours truly.

spans.text: Then leave the careful tending to yours truly.

units.rawText: Just like its name, the Oasis will become the hope of every Doll and Agent in the Cloud.
units.displayText: Just like its name, the Oasis will become the hope of every Doll and Agent in the Cloud.

spans.text: Just like its name, the Oasis will become the hope of every Doll and Agent in the Cloud.

units.rawText: Yeah.
units.displayText: Yeah.

spans.text: Yeah.

units.rawText: Professor, sorry to interrupt your conversation.
units.displayText: Professor, sorry to interrupt your conversation.

spans.text: Professor, sorry to interrupt your conversation.

units.rawText: I have a few documents about the Oasis construction I'd like to confirm. Especially this part here. I wanted to ask where the data for this operand discrepancy came from.
units.displayText: I have a few documents about the Oasis construction I'd like to confirm. Especially this part here. I wanted to ask where the data for this operand discrepancy came from.

spans.text: I have a few documents about the Oasis construction I'd like to confirm. Especially this part here. I wanted to ask where the data for this operand discrepancy came from.

units.rawText: For a moment the numbers on the page looked unfamiliar. To answer his question, I had no choice but to dig through my terminal and piece the information together.
units.displayText: For a moment the numbers on the page looked unfamiliar. To answer his question, I had no choice but to dig through my terminal and piece the information together.

spans.text: For a moment the numbers on the page looked unfamiliar. To answer his question, I had no choice but to dig through my terminal and piece the information together.

units.rawText: Well...
units.displayText: Well...

spans.text: Well...

units.rawText: Ah, that data is for the warehouse construction in Zone G. The operand fluctuates because we calculated the road connections between buildings and left a margin.
units.displayText: Ah, that data is for the warehouse construction in Zone G. The operand fluctuates because we calculated the road connections between buildings and left a margin.

spans.text: Ah, that data is for the warehouse construction in Zone G. The operand fluctuates because we calculated the road connections between buildings and left a margin.

units.rawText: The expected discrepancy is around 7%. Once tomorrow's meeting is over, the exact total will be set, and construction can begin.
units.displayText: The expected discrepancy is around 7%. Once tomorrow's meeting is over, the exact total will be set, and construction can begin.

spans.text: The expected discrepancy is around 7%. Once tomorrow's meeting is over, the exact total will be set, and construction can begin.

units.rawText: I see, that makes sense now! Thank you, Miss Inola!
units.displayText: I see, that makes sense now! Thank you, Miss Inola!

spans.text: I see, that makes sense now! Thank you, Miss Inola!

units.rawText: Hmhm, that's only natural for a secretary.
units.displayText: Hmhm, that's only natural for a secretary.

spans.text: Hmhm, that's only natural for a secretary.

units.rawText: After waving goodbye, Inola walked up close to me with a sly grin.
units.displayText: After waving goodbye, Inola walked up close to me with a sly grin.

spans.text: After waving goodbye, Inola walked up close to me with a sly grin.

units.rawText: Well, Professor? Aren't you going to praise yours truly's excellent abilities?
units.displayText: Well, Professor? Aren't you going to praise yours truly's excellent abilities?

spans.text: Well, Professor? Aren't you going to praise yours truly's excellent abilities?

units.rawText: Yeah, it's all thanks to you, Inola. I wouldn't have known how to handle that otherwise.
units.displayText: Yeah, it's all thanks to you, Inola. I wouldn't have known how to handle that otherwise.
